_note: Every ruleset version that has ever produced an export in this folder must be declared here. The importer refuses a version it has not been told about, so an unfamiliar build becomes a decision rather than something that slips through stamped with a stale value. This file is also the changelog the methodology page publishes. Start a new collection by declaring its first version as 'baseline'.

_kinds.baseline: The first version imported here. Nothing precedes it to compare against.
_kinds.rule-change: A new rule. Applies forward from effectiveFrom; earlier rounds keep the scoring they were published under and are never restated. Movement across the boundary is suppressed, because a delta spanning two rulesets measures the rule change as much as the participant.
_kinds.bug-fix: Restores what the stated rules always meant. History is recomputed and republished as a correction, and movement across the boundary stays meaningful.
_kinds.export-only: Changed what the export carries, not how anything is scored. Movement is retained — no number moved.

my-ledger-v1.0.note: Delete this block and declare the real first version under 'rulesets' below. The id is the rulesetPrefix from import-config.json joined to the source app's own build stamp.
